summary: 8 film announcements, 11 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Deep End
film.talent: Shawn Levy (21 Laps), Alex Cooper (Unwell Productions)
film.announcement: Netflix acquired film adaptation rights to Ali Hazelwood's adult romance novel. Shawn Levy's 21 Laps and Alex Cooper's Unwell Productions are producing the feature.

film.title: Thud
film.announcement: Grim Reaper-Devil romance film rounds out cast with six final additions including Brandon Scott and Vincent Rodriguez III.

film.title: Diya
film.announcement: Animated Bollywood-focused musical in development at Paramount with producers Jonathan Goldstein and John Francis Daley attached.

film.title: Exit to the Guillotine
film.announcement: Psychological thriller starring Peyton List and Gustaf Skarsgård has wrapped filming.

film.title: Wildwood
film.announcement: Stop-motion animated adventure film from Laika with Portland setting announced with teaser poster.

film.title: Carnival of the Animals
film.announcement: 2D animated special featuring conductor Gustavo Dudamel in partnership with PBS Kids.

film.title: Theater Kids Vs. Zombies
film.announcement: Musical microdrama being developed by Jesse Tyler Ferguson and Justin Mikita for aTwist.

film.title: The Green Eyes
film.announcement: Refugee adventure drama receives exclusive trailer reveal.

tv.title: I Love LA
tv.talent: Taron Egerton, Jamie Chung, Milan Carter
tv.announcement: Season 2 adds Taron Egerton, Jamie Chung, Milan Carter and three additional actors in guest star roles.

tv.title: Gilmore Girls Documentary
tv.announcement: Documentary series in development at HBO Max featuring Lauren Graham and never-before-seen footage from the original series.

tv.title: The Five Star Weekend
tv.announcement: Peacock renewed series for Season 2 after becoming the streamer's most-watched scripted series ever.

tv.title: The Secret of Secrets
tv.talent: Cherry Jones, Corey Stoll, Rob Delaney, Abbey Lee
tv.announcement: Netflix TV adaptation of Dan Brown novel adds Cherry Jones, Corey Stoll, Rob Delaney and Abbey Lee to cast.

tv.title: Trauma
tv.announcement: Medical hostage thriller series starring Richard Madden set at Paramount+ and Prime Video UK.

tv.title: Disinherited
tv.announcement: FX drama adds Avi Nash to cast.

tv.title: The Varnell Hill Show
tv.announcement: Martin spinoff sets September release date and drops first look photos.

tv.title: The Shards
tv.announcement: Ryan Murphy's adaptation of Bret Easton Ellis bestseller is available to watch on FX.

tv.title: Sterling Point
tv.announcement: Megan Park's YA series examines teen drama with refreshing realism and includes Ella Rubin in cast.

tv.title: The Challenge: Cutthroat II
tv.announcement: Season 42 of The Challenge with Cutthroat format announced with cast revealed.
